g.text: INITIAL ISSUE. REPLACES REV B SKETCHES
PASSIVE ACOUSTIC SENSOR NODE, SENSOR HEAD
INTERPRET DIMENSIONS AND TOLERANCES PER ASME Y14.5-2018.
MATERIAL: POLYCARBONATE SHEET, CLEAR, 3 THICK NOMINAL.
REMOVE ALL BURRS. BREAK SHARP EDGES 0.3 MAX.
ORDINATE DIMENSIONS ARE FROM THE LOWER LEFT CORNER OF THE
AT ASSEMBLY, MATCH DRILL 2X Ø6.6 THRU INSIDE THE PHANTOM
RECTANGLE TO TWO 1/4-20 UNC HOLES OF THE ADAPTER PLATE
(SLM-PAS-A01 ITEM 2). ITEM 2 HOLE SPACING IS NOT VERIFIED.
PHANTOM CIRCLE AND MICROPHONE PORT POSITIONS ARE REFERENCE
ONLY, FROM MANUFACTURER DATA. MEASURE THE PURCHASED CASE
MARK +X AND +Y ON THE PART ONLY AFTER AXIS TEST HB-5
PRELIMINARY. THIS PART HAS NOT BEEN CUT OR FITTED.
